In this video, I’m spotlighting Netflix FLOPS that actually rock—top-notch but often overlooked filmmaking that deserve far more attention. These are the kinds of movies that quietly land on Netflix, disappear from the conversation, and then years later make you wonder: How did everyone miss this? We've got bleak crime thrillers, inaccurate historical epics and the most raw character studies Netflix ever produced. This list focuses on forgotten and underrated Netflix movies that are absolutely worth revisiting.
